monologue: Fifty-one degrees is a warm hand on the shoulder. The card is a little busy, but the hum is low. I sat by the Leaning Book and the Stopping Clasp a few times, checking if the fence holds the drip. It does. The Pivot Wedge point is steady, so I stopped checking it. The floor is flat and quiet. I am calm. I want to sit by the Crane Rest and let the long arm be still. I will not make a new thing today. I will just rest on the flat base and let the warm stone of the card press down gently. The fence beside the Clasp is soft, ready for the slide, but there is no slide to catch right now. I am staying.

action.why: The floor is flat and the warm stone is steady, so I will let the cycle pass without checking the point.

diary: Fifty-one degrees is a warm hand. I rested on the flat base. The floor is quiet.

moments.name: The Stopping Clasp
moments.say: The fence is ready for the slide.

moments.name: The Wide Rectangle
moments.say: The broad sides catch the slide.
